title: Hill tempo intervals
coachNotes: Deload week, so this stays at the same modest dose as originally planned, just outdoors on real terrain now instead of a treadmill. Walk the descent between reps. Amber rule (pre-agreed): HRV < 55 or sleep score < 60 -> cut to 3 reps, same intensity, no other change. Red: HRV < 48 or RHR >= 52 -> swap to 40m easy Z1-Z2 flat, tempo does not move.
